economy.summary: His campaign platform supports raising the minimum wage to at least $15 an hour across Pennsylvania, the right of every worker to unionize, and investment in good union jobs on long-term projects such as rebuilding roads and bridges.
economy.short: Supports $15 minimum wage, union rights, infrastructure union jobs.

taxes.summary: His platform proposes diversifying local revenue streams to decrease reliance on property taxes and instituting a progressive property tax so that taxes are not raised on the most vulnerable residents.
taxes.short: Proposes progressive property tax; diversifying revenue beyond property taxes.

abortion.summary: His platform says he will oppose any and all efforts to curb access to abortion on demand, and supports legislation to make prenatal and postnatal care more affordable.
abortion.short: Opposes curbs on abortion access; supports affordable prenatal care.

education.summary: His platform pledges to advocate for fair funding for Lancaster schools and to oppose the construction and expansion of charter schools.
education.short: Supports fair school funding; opposes charter school expansion.

healthcare.summary: His platform supports Medicare for All legislation at the state and federal level and increased funding for Medicaid, CHIP, and other healthcare programs.
healthcare.short: Supports Medicare for All; increased Medicaid and CHIP funding.

energy.summary: His platform supports a statewide ban on fracking, working to decouple Pennsylvania's economy from natural gas extraction, and union jobs transitioning the state to renewable energy.
energy.short: Supports statewide fracking ban; transition to renewable energy jobs.

guns.summary: His platform supports community-based efforts to end the gun violence epidemic; on public safety more broadly it also calls for ending qualified immunity and life-without-parole sentences.
guns.short: Supports community-based gun violence prevention; ending qualified immunity.
